method: 65 authored semantic/policy cases, independently stated expectations; candidate commands were analyzed only. Fixed benign oracle probes ran in a disposable directory. No database statements or hazardous commands were executed.
limitations: Targeted regression corpus, selected after inspecting gaps; not an unbiased accuracy benchmark
Known impact and incomplete coverage are distinct
No full SQL, shell, or arbitrary-program soundness claim
